drop: Drop a CBZ here to start reading
privacy: Your comic stays in this browser. No uploads or remote content.
invalid: Choose a CBZ file. CBR and other archive formats are not supported.
damaged: The archive could not be read. It may be damaged or use unsupported ZIP features.
empty: This archive contains no image pages. Hidden files and archive metadata are ignored.
resourceLimit: The browser could not allocate enough resources. Close other tabs or try a device with more memory, then reopen the comic.
noReadable: No readable pages were found. Page positions are preserved so you can inspect each problem.
unsupportedPage: This image format is not supported. JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, and browser-supported AVIF images can be displayed. SVG is not rendered.
encryptedPage: This page is password protected. Encrypted pages cannot be opened here.
damagedPage: This image could not be displayed. It may be damaged, use an unsupported encoding, or exceed the browser's image decoding resources.
partial: {count} page(s) could not be displayed. Their original page positions are preserved. Other pages are checked as you read.
keyboard: In the reading area, use Left/Right arrows to turn pages in the selected reading direction. Page Down/Up always moves forward/back; Home/End jumps to the first/last page.
order: Pages follow natural order by full folder and file path. Comic metadata does not change the sequence.
encrypted: This archive is password protected. Encrypted archives cannot be opened here.
